hints.title: Evaluate Dominant Pile
hints.text: Let the sorted pile sizes be a <= b <= c. If c >= a + b, then c can pair with every stone from a and b.

hints.title: Balanced Piles Sum
hints.text: If c < a + b, stones from all three piles can be paired almost completely, leaving at most 1 stone.

hints.title: Closed Form Formula
hints.text: The maximum score is min(a + b, (a + b + c) // 2).

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating stone picks using a priority queue takes O(total_stones * log 3) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Mathematical deduction computes maximum score in constant O(1) time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate deduces the closed-form min(a + b, (a + b + c) / 2) parity bound.
